fair_value.method: By Sep 2027 the market prices FY2028 earnings: FY2027 consensus EPS ~$9.59 (+~13% on FY2026 ~$8.51 consensus) grown ~10% to ~$10.55 FY2028 (revenue ~+8-10%, memory-cost margin drag partly offset by price increases, ~2% annual share shrink from ~$100B/yr buybacks), times a 31x forward multiple (between the 5-yr average ~27x and today's ~35x, justified by services mix >70% GM and AI-Siri cycle) = ~$327, plus ~$1.10 dividends = ~$330. Cross-check: TTM FCF ~$137B on ~14.6B shares = ~$9.35/sh; a 3.0% FCF yield on ~$10.3 FY28 FCF/sh gives ~$343.

bear.story: Memory 'hundred-year flood' persists into 2027 (Samsung quoting ~$2.00/Gb vs $1.50), product GM falls below 36%, supply constraints cap iPhone 18/Duo units, price hikes dent demand; tariff-refund comp and possible chip tariffs (China semis rate rises June 2027) push FY2027 EPS toward ~$9.0 and the multiple de-rates toward the ~27x historical average (~27x x $9.3 FY28 ~ $250). A broad market/AI-trade correction or adverse DC Circuit ruling on Google default payments (~$20B/yr, nearly all margin) deepens it.

base.story: iPhone 18 Pro/Duo super-cycle plus Siri AI (iOS 27) drives FY2027 revenue ~+10% to ~$525B; margin pressure from memory largely offset by pricing and services growth (~12%); EPS ~$9.6 FY27 and ~$10.5 FY28 in line with consensus; multiple compresses modestly from ~35x to ~33x forward. Stock grinds roughly flat-to-up mid single digits including buybacks.

bull.story: Foldable iPhone Duo and AI Siri spark an extended upgrade cycle across a ~1.5B+ iPhone base, supply constraints ease, memory prices peak by mid-2027, gross margin holds ~47-48%, services AI monetization emerges; FY28 EPS ~$11.5 and market keeps a ~37-38x premium multiple under new CEO Ternus. Google appeal leaves payments intact.

thesis_break_reason: ~25% below the current price and ~24x FY2028 consensus-type EPS, i.e. below the 5-year average multiple on earnings that would themselves have to be falling: trading there would most likely mean estimates are being cut (memory costs crushing product GM, iPhone Duo/18 demand failing after price hikes, loss or restructuring of the ~$20B Google default-search payment, or new broad semiconductor tariffs), not ordinary 25%-vol noise. It is also near the bottom of the 52-week range ($243).

catalysts.event: iPhone Duo (foldable, $1,999) pre-orders; in stores Oct 23 - early demand/supply read
FQ4 2026 earnings (est. ~Oct 29) and first guide under CEO Ternus; December-quarter memory/margin guide is key (consensus FQ4 EPS ~$1.98, rev ~$115B)
FQ1 2027 holiday-quarter earnings (approx. late Jan): iPhone 18/Duo cycle strength vs supply constraints
DC Circuit arguments/ruling on Google search remedies appeal; DOJ seeks ban on default payments to Apple
FQ2 2027 earnings (approx.) plus annual capital return update (buyback authorization, dividend raise)
WWDC 2027 (AI roadmap) and scheduled step-up of US tariff on Chinese-origin semiconductors (June 23, 2027)
FQ3 2027 earnings (approx.): laps tariff-refund benefit, 2027 memory contract costs visible in margins
iPhone 19 / next-cycle launch event and pricing (further price hikes expected for memory)

key_uncertainties: Duration and size of DRAM/NAND cost inflation (TrendForce ~400% YoY on some iPhone memory; UBS models product GM 37-38% FY27) versus Apple's ability to pass through price increases without hurting units
Whether the current ~35x forward P/E (vs ~27x 5-yr average) holds; multiple compression is the dominant downside driver even with in-line earnings
Supply constraints on advanced nodes limiting iPhone 18/Duo shipments
Google default-search payments (~$20B/yr, very high margin) under DOJ appeal
Tariffs: semiconductor Section 232 actions and China chip tariff step-up in June 2027; non-recurrence of FY2026 tariff refunds ($0.11 EPS in FQ3)
Execution under new CEO John Ternus (since Sept 1, 2026) and real monetization of Gemini-trained Siri AI
Broad market/AI-trade regime: Apple is ~$5T market cap, highly index-correlated
reasoning: Start from base rates: AAPL realized vol 25%, typical mega-cap 1-yr moves +/-25-35%; I use a ~27% log-vol (slightly above realized given a new CEO, a margin shock and elevated valuation) with fatter left tail. Center: the stock is at a record ($341, ~35x FY27 consensus EPS $9.59, ~40x trailing) after +35% in a year driven by an iPhone 17/18 super-cycle (FQ3 revenue +16%, iPhone +22%, Mac +29%, EPS +29%) and the Siri AI/iPhone Duo launches. But FQ3 margins were flattered by ~2pts of tariff refunds, FQ4 guide was only +9-11% with 47-48% GM, management calls memory a '100-year flood' that will get worse, and 2027 memory contracts are ~30-40% higher. Consensus already has ~13% FY27 EPS growth; my FY28 EPS ~$10.5 at a 31x multiple gives fair value ~$330, just under spot, while analyst mean targets cluster ~$328-342 (range $245-400), i.e. roughly zero implied upside. Buybacks (~2%/yr) and dividends (~0.3%) add carry; momentum and product-cycle strength argue against a sharp de-rating near term. Net: median ~$345-350 (roughly flat to +2%), P(>=341) ~0.53. Scenario mix bear $250 (25%) / base $350 (50%) / bull $440 (25%) gives a mean ~$348, consistent with the ladder. Tails: a fall below $239 (-30%) needs both de-rating to historic multiples and estimate cuts or a market drawdown (~10%); above $460 (+35%) needs sustained 37x+ multiple and beat-and-raise earnings (~14.5%). Extreme strikes ($85, $853) are near-certain/near-impossible for a $5T cash-generative company in 12 months.
